verdict.rationale: An authenticator app could plausibly offer in-product AI insights or suggestions, such as security recommendations about stored accounts, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows any AI-generated insight or suggestion feature. The documented features are QR scanning, imports, encrypted backups, sharing, notes, trash and lock screens, and the llms.txt file only describes the site for external LLMs, not an in-product capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
